records.observation:
Entire1497-line javap displayed in five consecutive untruncated slices1–300,301–600,601–900,901–1200,1201–1497. JViewport implements time/component/mouse/key listeners. Constructor stores ModelTime, point(0,0), zoom modefalse/buttonsnull, own ComponentListener, empty viewport bounds; does not self-register with ModelTime. setView first superclass changes actual view, copies nonnull min/max/preferred sizes, then casts ScrollableView and further ScrollableObject for CoordPixelImage. Null/incompatible component can fail AFTER view change. Every setView adds same viewport as mouse/motion/key listener again, replaces info_dialogs with fresh ArrayList and close listeners; no removal, disposal or migration of prior list/dialogs. Normal initial call recorded in TimelinePanel; repeat hazard is conditional, not asserted normal usage.
TimeChanged ignores event payload beyond debug: if view exists checkZoom THEN checkScroll, refresh x from view, preserve stored y, superclass setViewPosition, repaint. Resize invokes view.componentResized(this), sets preferred viewport current size, updates x/setViewPosition/repaint. setYaxisViewPosition only mutates stored point; getX returns stored point; moved/hidden/shown debug-only, no cleanup.
paint first superclass, updates mutable viewport bounds from CURRENT model position/extent and resets coord transform, with no pre-setView null guard. If instant zoom disabled draws red focus line when contained. Draw current zoom box (white line,purple132/112/255 alpha96), current info box and every stored duration dialog bounds (green line,yellow alpha64), others clicked-time line. No isVisible/isDisplayable check. Shading checks overlap, converts contained endpoints else clamps to0/width, fills interior xStart+1,widthDifference-1 only when end>start; modifies Graphics color without restoring. Dialog list concurrent modification not guarded. Normal mouse lifecycle closes through listeners below; externally disposed dialogs not removed by this class.
initLeftMouseToZoom stores flag, creates fresh grouped zoom/hand radio buttons, optional image resources using gray default/original selected icons with border vs text fallback, attaches $1/$2, doClick requested mode BEFORE its group.add, exposes panel builder only if both buttons nonnull. createLeftMouseModePanel(layoutAxis) adds SAME buttons so repeated panels reparent them; invalid layout axis delegated to BoxLayout. Mode listeners only set flag, no immediate cursor update. setCursor checks IDENTITY to CustomCursor.Normal and substitutes ZoomPlus/HandOpen, other cursor passed through. mouseEnter requests focus and sets mode cursor directly; moved/exited noop. Key Shift toggles plus→minus and release minus→plus by cursor identity, regardless instant-zoom setting; ESC clears zoom_timebox/repaints only, not info selection or dialogs.
MousePressed refreshes viewport bounds/transform, maps x to time; leftzoom new zero-length zoom box/repaint/plus, lefthand close-hand, right new zero-length info box/repaint; records pressed time/x and lastx for all buttons. Clicked leftzoom sets zoom focus; instant setting causes Shift zoomOut else zoomIn and cursor update/optional toolbar reset; otherwise repaint focus only. Always requests focus, no click-count restriction. MouseDragged maps current x using transform which paint/press refresh; Shift+minus resets cursorplus, leftzoom updates ONLY latest if current>pressed else ONLY earliest (no reset opposite endpoint), lefthand scroll(lastx-currentx) then lastx/cursor, right similarly updates info bound without null guard. Cross-anchor drag can retain prior opposite-side endpoint; not a pure min/max of press and current. Release repeats one-sided bound update. For leftzoom, abs(releaseX-pressedX)>=Parameters.MIN_WIDTH_TO_DRAG performs zoomRapidly(earliest,duration) then midpoint focus; clear zoom box/repaint/plus and optional toolbar reset even below threshold. ESC null prevents this release operation but separate mouseClicked may still occur. Lefthand applies final incremental scroll if x changed then HandOpen. Integer subtraction/abs threshold, nonfinite durations, null info and direction changes have no extra validation.
Right release threshold uses final horizontal displacement only (not vertical or path length). At/above threshold constructs InfoDialogForDuration with retained info_timebox and ScrollableObject, owner Frame if instance else Dialog cast. Below threshold convertPoint(viewport,releasePoint,scrollable) then getPropertyAt(convertedPoint,viewport_timebox), connecting CanvasTimeline picking with current viewport filter. Copies release point→screen, calls dialog.setVisibleAtLocation FIRST, THEN registers shared close-button/window listeners, appends dialog to list, clears info box/repaints. No null-dialog check/finally/screen clamp; failure can leave partial visible dialog/selection. Existing InfoDialog constructors use nonmodal overload, so ordinary event turn proceeds to wiring, not modal wait. Normal route NOW resolves prior pending close wiring: both button and window handlers dispose/remove matching dialog. getLastInfoDialog returns last list element else null, no display status filter. No close-all/dispose hook, event unregistration or worker cancellation; inherited owner disposal and downstream models separately scoped. All synthetic accessors/static palette fully read. Archived code never executed.

records.observation: Complete61-line javap. Captures viewport and original list references plus outer. On action iterates captured list, matches source identity to each dialog.getCloseButton(), removes dialog via list.remove (not iterator.remove), dispose then viewport.repaint and exits loop immediately, so no next iterator step and no inevitable ConcurrentModificationException claim. Unmatched source no-op. Exceptions after removal leave partial state. List binding persists if outer setView replaces list; no worker cancellation or own listener detachment.

records.observation: Complete60-line javap. WindowAdapter handles windowClosing only; captures viewport and original list. Finds dialog by source identity, list.remove, dispose, repaint, exits. No windowClosed handler, so external programmatic disposal alone does not prune this list via this listener. Immediate loop exit means list.remove does not automatically cause iterator failure. Completes ordinary titlebar-close behavior for InfoDialog DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE; no blanket lack-of-close defect.
